neighbours.label: 'and' directly after a dash (--and / —and), resuming after an interruption
fire: Her father--and later her brother--ran the old mill.
The mayor--and most of the council--opposed the plan.
Bring a coat--and maybe an umbrella--for the hike.
The teachers--and the parents too--signed the letter.
The coach—and his whole staff—were fired on Monday.
Our neighbors--and their three dogs--moved away last spring.
The engine—and the gearbox with it—failed on the hill.
The bank--and its lawyers--refused to comment.

Bring a coat, a hat and maybe an umbrella for the hike.
